title: Sulfonated porous organic polymer supported Ziegler–Natta catalysts for the synthesis of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34578-34585
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06166G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wenqian Kang, Xiong Wang, Yue Ren, Pingsheng Zhang, Anping Huang, Guangquan Li
Sulfonated POP (s-POP) supported Ziegler–Natta catalysts were used for ethylene polymerization, producing ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene, with Mν reaching up to 6.83 × 106 g mol−1.
